ExplanationParts.CorpusEarnedOpening: To raise is a narrated physical action in which an implement is lifted before or within an encounter.
EvidenceBody: Recorders narrate Dahui, Ziling, Mi'an, Miyun, Baizhang, Shiqi, Yongji, and Yantou raising implements.

Senses.Note: 8 exact witnesses from 8 independent works delimit this sense.
